sloka: रूप संहननम् लक्ष्मीम् सौकुमार्यम् सुवेषताम् ।ददृशुर् विस्मित आकारा रामस्य वन वासिनः ॥३-१-१३॥
transliteration: rūpa saṁhananam lakṣmīm saukumāryam suveṣatām ।dadṛśur vismita ākārā rāmasya vana vāsinaḥ ॥3-1-13॥

translations.english: Those sages living in the forest were wonderstruck to see the handsome, graceful, delicate and welldressed Rama.
